mails.subject: Re: SV: Your yearbook archive is why Copenhagen has a page at all
mails.body:
Hi Hans Erik,

Thank you, that list did more for us than anything anybody has sent so far.
Copenhagen went from sixteen trees to forty-two this week, and thirty-two of
them now carry one of your photographs with your name under it.

https://ancienttrees.app/copenhagen

The Dyrehaven oaks are all up, Trepileegen, Kuppelegen, Vorteegen and
Fortunegen, and so are the Zelkova at Landbohoejskolen, the pagoda tree on
Rolighedsvej and the cherry avenue at Bispebjerg. We used all of your data, so
your whole list is in our database with your measurements.

If you have more of these, in Denmark or anywhere else in the world, I would
be very glad of them.

Our app is live too. If you visit another city, take it with you and tell me
how it holds up out there.
https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/ancient-trees/id6806177833?l=en-GB

Later on we want to build proper walks through these cities, past several trees
in one afternoon. I would like to come back to you when we do.

Thanks again,
Hidde
mails.resend_reason: He wrote to us first, on 2026-09-20, with a list of sixty Copenhagen register trees and written permission for his photographs. This is the answer to that mail. Peter Hoffmann is cc'd because he forwarded our question to him.

mails.subject: Re: Can you help me with ancienttrees.app? Stockholm
mails.body:
Hi Daniel,

You will have been to Prague by now. Did you use the app while you were there?
I would really like to hear how it went, good or bad. You are the first person
I know of who took it into a city they did not know.

If you found trees we are missing, you can add them from the app yourself,
photograph and all.

Hidde
mails.resend_reason: Second mail in a live thread. He wrote on 2026-09-07 that he had used the app to plan a Prague trip 'coming up in a couple of weeks'; Hidde answered on 2026-09-10 and asked how the planning went. The trip has now happened, so this asks how the walk went. No cc: the earlier mail carried a line to Tina Axelsson and this one does not, so it is a note to him.
